text:
Type: slim black LED desk lamp
Use: focused task light for working or reading at a desk; home office, study, bedroom
Style: minimalist, modern, industrial
Materials: black coated steel tube frame, brushed aluminium LED head and base end, black cord
Colors: black, brushed silver
Shape: single continuous bent tube rising from a triangular loop base, narrow bar light head on a flexible neck, very thin and graphic, small footprint
Feel: sleek, graphic, discreet, modern
Goes with: dark wood or white desks, grey walls, metal accents; minimalist, modern or industrial home offices

product.name: HRTE
product.description: Easy to use in different places as you can power the lamp through the USB port on your computer or an ordinary power socket.
